newsitem.title: INDIA: Low arrivals, speculation drive India castor down.
newsitem.headline: Low arrivals, speculation drive India castor down.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery dropped further to 1,182/1,183 rupees from 1,186/1,187 rupees per quintal on renewed speculative selling, dealers said.

"Fresh arrivals of castorseed, however, remained low but absence of overseas buying and reports that exporters from Brazil have turned active sellers in the world market prompted fresh bull liquidation," one dealer said.
"With the mid-crop of castorseed in Brazil expected higher it is becoming a seller in world markets."
Castorseed arrivals in Gujarat were low at 6,000/7,000 bags (75 kg each) due to the end of the fiscal year on March 31.

Groundnut oil fell from 350 rupees to 347/348 rupees per 10 kg on fresh arrivals of 80/100 tonnes which prompted light profit-taking. Imported palm-oil was steady at 280/281 rupees per 10 kg amid the absence of fresh arrivals at Bombay port while physical buying remained slow.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 520/525 rupees per 15 kg. --Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
